items.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need,' but analysts warn of volatility
items.title_zh: 人为首次公开募股“正是市场所需要的”，但分析师警告波动性
items.summary: The Anthropic IPO is "what the markets need." However, analysts say its shares will be volatile in the coming weeks.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic IPO 是“市场所需要的”。不过，分析师表示，未来几周该公司股价将出现波动。

items.title: Senate passes BAAJA permitting reform bill backed by AI, energy sectors
items.title_zh: 参议院通过由人工智能、能源部门支持的 BAAJA 许可改革法案
items.summary: The permitting bill's Senate passage is a key step to it becoming law, but it would also need to clear the House before heading to President Trump's desk.
items.summary_zh: 该法案在参议院获得通过是其成为法律的关键一步，但在提交特朗普总统办公桌之前还需要获得众议院的批准。

items.title: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
items.title_zh: Anthropic 首次亮相后，亚洲科技股遭遇人工智能抛售，软银股价暴跌 16% 以上
items.summary: The declines in Asia come after the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite fell more than 2% overnight following Anthropic's highly anticipated Wall Street debut.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 在备受期待的华尔街首次亮相后，以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数隔夜下跌超过 2%，亚洲股市也随之下跌。

items.title: ‘Hanuman Ansh,’ ‘Pyre’ and Shah Rukh Khan Classics Lead International Film Festival of India’s Inflatable Cinema Lineup as NFDC, ESG Renew PictureTime Partnership
items.title_zh: NFDC 与 ESG 续签 PictureTime 合作伙伴关系，《哈努曼安什》、《火葬场》和沙鲁克汗经典领衔印度国际电影节充气影院阵容
items.summary: Vishal Chaturvedi’s hit “Hanuman Ansh” and Vinod Kapri’s “Pyre” will headline a pop-up inflatable cinema at the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa, where the National Film Development Corporation (NFDC) and the Entertainment…
items.summary_zh: 维沙尔·查图维迪 (Vishal Chaturvedi) 的热门影片《哈努曼·安什》(Hanuman Ansh) 和维诺德·卡普里 (Vinod Kapri) 的《火葬场》(Pyre) 将在果阿举行的印度国际电影节 (IFFI) 上的一个弹出式充气电影院中亮相，国家电影发展公司 (NFDC) 和娱乐公司将在果阿举办该电影节。

items.title: ‘War’ Stars Sienna Miller and Dominic West Tussle Over Who Won the Divorce Drama: ‘Gwyneth Paltrow Ran So That the Rest of Us Could Walk’
items.title_zh: 《战争》主演西耶娜·米勒和多米尼克·韦斯特争论谁赢得了离婚剧：“格温妮丝·帕特洛跑了，这样我们其他人就可以走路了”
items.summary: SPOILER ALERT: This article contains major spoilers for “War,” which had its season finale on Nov. 19 on HBO and HBO Max in the U.S., and drops on Nov. 20 on Sky and NOW in the U.K.
items.summary_zh: 剧透警告：本文包含《战争》的主要剧透，该剧于 11 月 19 日在美国 HBO 和 HBO Max 播出季终集，并于 11 月 20 日在英国 Sky 和 ​​NOW 播出。

items.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
items.title_zh: 苹果可能正在开发自己的人工智能代理来运行你的Mac
items.summary: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.
items.summary_zh: 这家 iPhone 制造商似乎正在打造能够与 Meta Muse、Instinct、Claude 和 OpenAI Dots 等公司竞争的代理。

items.title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
items.title_zh: Anthropic 的 7 位创始人在破纪录的 IPO 中套现近 20 亿美元
items.summary: At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion.
items.summary_zh: 按照升级后的 83 美元/股 IPO 价格计算，Anthropic 的七位创始人每人赚了 2.8 亿美元，而公司则获得了近 1050 亿美元。

items.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
items.title_zh: 苹果正在招聘工程师来构建自己的人工智能代理
items.summary: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services.
items.summary_zh: 苹果正在开发自己的人工智能代理，它可以为你执行一系列任务，包括浏览网页、跨应用程序工作、编写代码和调用服务。
